pattern.description: The headline fades out while a floating gradient orb rises to centre and swells; the orb's fill dissolves into a circular presenter video (mask reveal inside the circle), the gradient ring shrinks away and a red record badge pops onto the rim. Camera pushes in throughout.
pattern.why_premium: A decorative background element is promoted into the hero UI object, so the transition from brand world to product (Loom's circular camera bubble) has visual continuity instead of a cut; the record badge lands last as a clear product cue.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.headline',{opacity:0,duration:0.25,ease:'power1.in'}); tl.fromTo('.orb',{x:orbX,y:orbY,scale:0.8},{x:0,y:0,scale:1.25,duration:0.35,ease:'power2.out'},0); tl.fromTo('.bubble-video',{opacity:0,scale:0.6},{opacity:1,scale:1,duration:0.3,ease:'power2.out'},0.25); tl.to('.orb-ring',{scale:0.9,opacity:0,duration:0.3,ease:'power2.inOut'},0.4); tl.fromTo('.rec-badge',{scale:0},{scale:1,duration:0.25,ease:'back.out(2)'},0.65); tl.to('.scene',{scale:1.1,duration:0.9,ease:'sine.inOut'},0); background spheres drift up with parallax (larger = faster).
build_hint.remotion: Headline opacity: interpolate(frame,[0,8],[1,0]). Orb travel/scale: spring({frame, fps, config:{damping:20, stiffness:140}}) mapped to x/y/scale. Video bubble: spring delayed ~8 frames to opacity/scale 0.6→1 with overflow hidden circle mask. Badge: spring({frame:frame-20, fps, config:{damping:10, stiffness:200}}) for slight overshoot. Scene container scale interpolate(frame,[0,30],[1,1.1]).

notes: Exact morph mechanics (orb fading into video vs. video masked inside the orb) are ambiguous between f192 and f197. Background-sphere motion is mostly the measured push_in plus parallax drift. b05 overlaps b03 (same lower-left sphere, spurious OCR '●'), so only b03 is used. b06 (top-left sphere edge) and b01 (union) omitted.
